description: This file sets the Norwegian ('nb') language translations for the 'uicolor' plugin in CKEditor, providing UI labels and descriptions for color selection features.

methods.name: setLang
methods.description: Sets the language-specific strings for a CKEditor plugin.

calls: CKEDITOR.plugins.setLang('uicolor','nb',{uicolor:{title:'Fargevelger for brukergrensesnitt',preview:'Forhåndsvisning i sanntid',config:'Lim inn følgende tekst i din config.js-fil',predefined:'Forhåndsdefinerte fargesett'}}})
